resources.string: Enter Mac connection info or scan to pair
Pairing token (in Mac menu-bar QR window)
Please fill in address and token
Discovering… (keep phone and Mac on the same Wi-Fi)
Selected %1$s — confirm token, then tap Connect
Camera permission is required for QR scanning
Aim at the pairing-QR window in the Mac menu bar
Test screen: no screen-recording permission or mock mode. Re-grant the agent in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording, then fully restart it
Mac screen-recording permission not granted: showing the test screen
Tap anywhere to stop — text goes to the cursor
Too short — tap the mic, then speak
Microphone permission is required for voice input
Previous recording still processing — wait a second
Cloud transcription not configured: fill the API URL in "Voice & advanced settings", or switch to on-device
Recognition returned nothing (vendor service may be unavailable); consider cloud transcription
Cannot create recognizer (%1$s). Use cloud transcription
No speech-recognition service on this device. Install Google "Speech Recognition & Synthesis" or switch to cloud
Microphone permission missing (app and speech service both need it)
Speech service network timeout (Google recognition needs access to Google services; use cloud in mainland China)
Speech service error (on Xiaomi-like devices accept the voice agreement in Mi AI and unfreeze the service)
Device speech service doesn\'t support Chinese (download the offline pack for Google services)
Cannot open the page — adjust it in system settings
Open "Voice & advanced settings" from the main screen to switch to cloud
Pick a speech-to-text engine (recognized text goes to the viewer input box for editing)
On-device: unavailable — no recognition service registered
On-device: unavailable — no default recognition service set
On-device: unavailable — default service (%1$s) disabled or frozen
Recognition services installed: %1$s\nDefault voice recognition service: %2$s
Install Google "Speech Recognition & Synthesis" (package %1$s; needs Google framework/Play Store), then set it as the default voice input in system settings; or use cloud transcription (recommended)
Google speech component detected but it provides no recognition service (TTS-only build or restricted). Enable it in app management, or use cloud transcription (recommended)

Go to Settings → More settings → Language & input ("Default apps → digital assistant" on some ROMs) → "Voice input", and pick the installed service (e.g. Google). If it\'s missing, enable the component in app management. Also exempt the component from battery freezing and allow auto-start
Vendor (Xiaomi) recognition: accept the voice agreement in Mi AI on first use; network required. "Speech service error" usually means the agreement isn\'t accepted yet

Google recognition: its server must be reachable (mainland networks usually need a proxy), and the Chinese offline pack must be downloaded on first use (this app requests offline mode). Prefer cloud transcription on timeout/server errors
Vendor recognition: on failure check its permissions and agreements; cloud transcription is also available
